name: HWR_WLNS_NEWS_B
description: This table holds the wellness news

columns.name: NEWS_ID
columns.description: This is the primary key for the table

columns.name: START_DATE
columns.description: This column stores the start date of the corresponding news

columns.name: END_DATE
columns.description: This column stores the end date of the corresponding news

columns.name: NEWS_LINK
columns.description: This column holds the link for the news

columns.name: NEWS_IMAGE
columns.description: This column holds image for the news

columns.name: ORDER_RANK
columns.description: This column stores the rank of the news

columns.name: IS_DELETED
columns.description: This column indicates whether the news deleted or not

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
